correctness.rationale: Complete-arch number equals subsequence-universality index: k arches embed every length-k pattern, and the consecutive arch-completion symbols followed by a missing suffix symbol form a greedily unmatchable (k+1)-pattern. For no-equal-adjacent hosts, at j collected letters there are j-1 legal repeats and q-j new letters, proving the stage rational products and exact bivariate generating function. First-letter q versus q-1 boundary normalization is explicit. At q=3 algebra gives (1+2z+3z²+2uz³)/(1-z-4uz³). Independent geometric waits yield arch length 1+Σ Geom((q-j)/(q-1)), with mean 1+(q-1)H_(q-1) and variance (q-1)^2 H^(2)_(q-1)-(q-1)H_(q-1), so classical span-one finite-exponential-moment renewal limits give the CLT and O(1) moment remainders. At q=3 negative binomial conversion proves exact binomial tails. Shortest hosts are boundary-compatible concatenations of permutations. Verifier replay on the actual included source checked 1,130,960 hosts, 112,420 literal embeddings, and 228 coefficients for q=2..6 in the stated ranges. Finite checks are not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The theorem concerns the exact all-q bivariate spectrum of k-subsequence universality in words with forbidden equal adjacent letters, with an exact ternary binomial survival law and explicit renewal fluctuation constants. Inspected primary counting papers address all words and general regular-language automata without stating this specialization in closed form. Nearby indexed binary universality results have a different alphabet/domain; the two-letter no-repeat case is deterministic and is expressly excluded from the nondegenerate CLT. Searches used aliases, parameter equations, and renewal formulations. No dominating explicit statement was located, subject to disclosed residual risks.

value.rationale: This identifies the complete index distribution over the natural regular language of proper path colorings for every alphabet size, not merely an algorithm for it. The ternary case is the first nondeterministic proper-coloring source and has a unexpectedly simple cubic-denominator generating function and exact finite fair-binomial survival law; the all-q renewal variance and CLT quantify the typical coverage tradeoff. The exact optimal-length host enumeration connects both extremes. These are motivated, nontrivial quantitative results for constrained universal test strings; no claim of novelty for the generic arch or renewal methods.
